english.note: Use this when an amount, measurement, fit, or timing is exactly right with nothing extra or missing.
Use 啱啱好 when something is exactly or perfectly right.

examples.english: The box is exactly the right size to fit all the cups.
examples.traditional: 個盒啱啱好放得晒啲杯。
examples.jyutping: go3 hap6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 fong3 dak1 saai3 di1 bui1

examples.english: This table is just big enough for the three of us.
examples.traditional: 呢張枱啱啱好夠我哋三個人坐。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 gau3 ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4 co5
